title: Disclosure Dossier / Investigative Architecture Draft
concise_intro: This draft prototype treats the dossier as the primary evidential object. Report sections and appendices remain the main reading routes, while the timeline acts as a navigable chronology that can progressively reveal how evidential items connect back into the dossier.
design_philosophy: The site opens as a dossier workspace rather than a timeline spectacle. Users can move from overview to sections, appendices, and the master timeline without losing the sense that the report body and evidence families are the core destinations.
